candidates.change_summary: Replace the increment of the caller's balance to add 0 instead of 20, so airDrop no longer increases caller's balance but still passes requires; observable tokenBalance may differ for keys if logic elsewhere expects increase.
Replace the increment to add 40 instead of 20, doubling the amount awarded by airDrop and changing tokenBalance for the caller (and possibly other observations).

Remove the lock release after the function body so _locked remains true after reentrant-protected functions, which changes whether subsequent airDrop calls succeed and thus alters observable tokenBalance across calls.
Change the hasNoBalance check to require the caller already has a positive balance, allowing airDrop to be called only when caller has >0 and thus altering which addresses' balances can change.
Modify supportsToken to compare against a different string, causing the supportsToken check to fail for the Bank implementation and preventing airDrop, thereby changing observed balances.
Replace the addition of 20 in airDrop with addition of 10, changing the amount credited to callers.
Remove the hasNoBalance modifier from airDrop so callers with nonzero balance can receive additional tokens.
Change the reentrancy guard to set _locked to false before the function body executes, breaking protection and potentially allowing reentrant changes to tokenBalance during airDrop.
Alter supportsToken to require a different literal ("Bad Token"), causing the supportsToken check to fail for the original Bank and preventing airDrop from crediting tokens.
Change hasNoBalance to require the caller already has a positive balance, inverting the guard so only addresses with nonzero balance can call airDrop.
